dataset.title: Iran–Israel–Gaza–Lebanon–Yemen Conflict Timeline
dataset.focus: Detailed coverage from 2026-02-28 onward, with major precursor events from 2020 onward and expanded Israel/Palestine/Lebanon/Yemen context.
dataset.granularity: Major independently verifiable escalation, retaliation, diplomatic, legal, maritime, leadership, ceasefire and deadline events; not missile-by-missile.
methodology_notes: This is a chronological event ledger, not a causal narrative.
Reuters/AP and primary institutions such as the ICC, ICJ, IAEA and UN are preferred as the factual spine where available.
Al Jazeera, CNN, DW, Euronews and other international outlets are used for chronology and cross-checking.
Government-aligned outlets are useful for documenting official claims but are not treated as independent confirmation of their own side's military claims.
The ICC, not the United Nations, issued arrest warrants for Benjamin Netanyahu and Yoav Gallant on 2024-11-21.

verification_labels.confirmed: Event established by multiple credible/independent sources or primary documentation.
verification_labels.legal_diplomatic: Court order, treaty, negotiation, ceasefire, memorandum or other documented official action.
verification_labels.attribution_disputed: Event occurred but responsibility or detailed attribution remains disputed or incompletely established.
verification_labels.official_claim: Important official statement or claim retained in the record but not independently established as fact.
verification_labels.unverified_contradicted: Available evidence does not substantiate the claim or credible evidence contradicts it.

events.title: U.S. drone strike kills Qassem Soleimani
events.summary: A U.S. drone strike near Baghdad International Airport, ordered by President Donald Trump, kills Iranian Quds Force commander Qassem Soleimani, Iraqi militia commander Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis, and others.

events.title: Trump warns of strikes on 52 Iranian targets
events.summary: Trump warns that if Iran retaliates, the United States has identified 52 Iranian targets, including sites he described as important to Iranian culture.

events.title: Iran launches ballistic missiles at U.S.-hosted bases in Iraq
events.summary: Iran launches more than a dozen ballistic missiles at Ain al-Asad airbase and a facility near Erbil hosting U.S. forces, explicitly retaliating for Soleimani. No U.S. troops are killed immediately, although traumatic brain injuries are subsequently reported.

events.title: Iranian nuclear scientist Mohsen Fakhrizadeh assassinated
events.summary: Iranian nuclear scientist Mohsen Fakhrizadeh is assassinated near Tehran. Iran attributes the killing to Israel; Israel does not publicly accept responsibility at the time.

events.title: IRGC launches ballistic missiles toward Erbil
events.summary: Iran's IRGC launches roughly a dozen ballistic missiles toward Erbil, saying it struck an Israeli strategic centre. Kurdish and U.S. officials say no U.S. facilities were hit; one civilian is reported injured.

claims.claim: The target was an Israeli strategic centre.

events.title: Hamas-led October 7 attack and start of Gaza war
events.summary: Hamas and allied Palestinian militants breach Israel's Gaza perimeter, attack communities and military positions, kill about 1,200 people and abduct roughly 250 hostages. Israel begins large-scale strikes on Gaza and declares war.

events.title: Hezbollah opens sustained Israel-Lebanon front
events.summary: Hezbollah fires at Israeli positions in the Shebaa Farms area, saying it is acting in solidarity with Palestinians. Israel responds with artillery. This begins the sustained Israel-Hezbollah front.

events.title: Israel expands ground operation in Gaza
events.summary: Israel substantially expands its ground operation inside Gaza. Netanyahu calls it the war's second stage.

events.title: Houthis seize Galaxy Leader
events.summary: Yemen's Houthis seize the cargo ship Galaxy Leader using a helicopter-borne boarding party, opening the major Red Sea shipping dimension of the conflict.

events.title: Temporary Gaza truce and hostage-prisoner exchanges
events.summary: A Qatar/Egypt/U.S.-mediated temporary truce pauses fighting. More than 100 hostages are released in exchange for Palestinian prisoners or detainees and increased humanitarian aid. Fighting resumes on December 1.

events.title: U.S. and UK strike Houthi targets in Yemen
events.summary: The U.S. and UK, supported by allies, strike Houthi targets in Yemen after repeated Houthi attacks on commercial shipping.

events.title: ICJ orders provisional measures in South Africa v. Israel
events.summary: The International Court of Justice orders provisional measures including measures to prevent acts prohibited by the Genocide Convention, prevent and punish incitement, and facilitate humanitarian assistance. The court does not rule that genocide has occurred.

events.title: Tower 22 drone attack kills three U.S. servicemembers
events.summary: A drone hits Tower 22, a U.S. installation in Jordan, killing three U.S. servicemembers and injuring dozens. Washington attributes the attack to an Iran-backed militia network; Tehran denies responsibility.

events.title: U.S. strikes more than 85 IRGC- and militia-linked targets
events.summary: The United States retaliates for Tower 22 by striking more than 85 IRGC- and militia-linked targets in Iraq and Syria.

events.title: Strike destroys Iranian consular annex in Damascus
events.summary: An airstrike destroys the Iranian consular annex in Damascus, killing senior Quds Force commander Mohammad Reza Zahedi and other IRGC officers. Iran and Syria attribute it to Israel; Israel does not initially formally claim it.

events.title: Iran conducts first large-scale direct attack on Israel
events.summary: Iran launches more than 300 drones and missiles at Israel from Iranian territory. The U.S., UK, Jordan and others assist Israel in interceptions. Iran describes the attack as retaliation for the Damascus strike.

events.title: Apparent Israeli retaliatory attack near Isfahan
events.summary: An apparent Israeli retaliatory attack occurs near Isfahan. Iranian officials play down the incident; no major casualties or infrastructure destruction are reported.

events.title: Israel orders Rafah evacuations and begins operations
events.summary: Israel orders evacuations and begins operations in eastern Rafah as ceasefire negotiations continue. Hamas says it accepts a mediator proposal; Israel says that proposal does not meet its requirements.

events.title: ICC prosecutor requests arrest warrants
events.summary: ICC Prosecutor Karim Khan requests arrest warrants for Netanyahu, Gallant and Hamas leaders including Yahya Sinwar, Mohammed Deif and Ismail Haniyeh.

events.title: ICJ issues additional provisional measures concerning Rafah
events.summary: The ICJ issues additional provisional measures concerning Rafah, ordering Israel to halt military action in Rafah under the circumstances specified by the court and to facilitate humanitarian access.

events.title: Israeli strike kills Hezbollah commander Fuad Shukr
events.summary: An Israeli strike in Beirut kills senior Hezbollah military commander Fuad Shukr.

events.title: Hamas political chief Ismail Haniyeh assassinated in Tehran
events.summary: Hamas political chief Ismail Haniyeh is assassinated while visiting Tehran. Iran and Hamas blame Israel. Israel initially does not formally claim the operation.

events.title: Hezbollah pager explosions across Lebanon
events.summary: Thousands of pagers used by Hezbollah personnel explode nearly simultaneously across Lebanon. At least nine people are initially reported killed and thousands injured.

claims.status: attributed by Hezbollah and Lebanon; not initially acknowledged by Israel

events.title: Second wave of communications-device explosions in Lebanon
events.summary: A second wave involving handheld radios and walkie-talkies explodes across Lebanon.

events.title: Israeli strike kills Hezbollah commander Ibrahim Aqil
events.summary: An Israeli strike kills Hezbollah operations commander Ibrahim Aqil and other senior figures.

events.title: Israeli strike kills Hezbollah leader Hassan Nasrallah
events.summary: A massive Israeli strike on Hezbollah's underground headquarters kills Hezbollah secretary-general Hassan Nasrallah. Hezbollah confirms his death the following day.

events.title: Israel begins ground incursion into southern Lebanon
events.summary: Israel begins a ground incursion into southern Lebanon, describing its operation as limited and focused on Hezbollah infrastructure.

events.title: Iran launches roughly 200 ballistic missiles at Israel
events.summary: Iran fires roughly 200 ballistic missiles at Israel, its second direct attack that year. Tehran cites the killings of Nasrallah, Haniyeh and an IRGC commander.

events.title: Israeli troops kill Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar
events.summary: Israeli troops kill Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar during fighting in Rafah. Hamas subsequently confirms his death.

events.title: Israel launches retaliatory strikes against Iranian military sites
events.summary: Israel launches several waves of retaliatory airstrikes against Iranian military sites, air defences and missile-production infrastructure, while avoiding Iranian nuclear and oil installations.

events.title: ICC issues arrest warrants for Netanyahu and Gallant
events.summary: ICC judges issue arrest warrants for Benjamin Netanyahu and Yoav Gallant, as well as Hamas military commander Mohammed Deif, alleging war crimes and crimes against humanity. This is the event often incorrectly described as the UN declaring Netanyahu a war criminal.

events.title: Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire takes effect
events.summary: A U.S.- and French-mediated Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire takes effect after more than a year of cross-border fighting.

events.title: Gaza ceasefire and hostage-release agreement announced
events.summary: Qatar announces an Israel-Hamas ceasefire and hostage-release agreement scheduled to begin on January 19.

events.title: Gaza ceasefire enters force
events.summary: The ceasefire enters force after a delay of several hours; hostage and prisoner exchanges begin.

events.title: Israel stops entry of food, fuel and other supplies into Gaza
events.summary: Israel stops entry of food, fuel and other supplies into Gaza amid disagreement over extending the first phase of the ceasefire.

events.title: Trump administration launches major new air campaign against Houthis
events.summary: The Trump administration launches a major new U.S. air campaign against Houthi targets in Yemen.

events.title: Israel resumes large-scale strikes in Gaza
events.summary: Israel resumes large-scale airstrikes in Gaza, effectively ending the January ceasefire's sustained pause in major combat.

events.title: Oman announces U.S.-Houthi ceasefire
events.summary: Oman announces a U.S.-Houthi ceasefire under which neither side will target the other, including U.S.-flagged vessels. It does not prohibit Houthi attacks on Israel.

events.title: Israel launches Operation Rising Lion
events.summary: Israel launches Operation Rising Lion, a large-scale surprise attack on Iranian nuclear facilities, missile infrastructure and military leadership. Senior commanders including IRGC chief Hossein Salami and chief of staff Mohammad Bagheri are killed, along with nuclear scientists. This begins the Twelve-Day War.

events.title: Iran begins large-scale missile and drone retaliation
events.summary: Iran begins large-scale ballistic-missile and drone retaliation against Israel.

events.title: Israeli attacks and Iranian retaliatory salvos intensify
events.summary: Israeli attacks expand to missile launchers, air-defence systems and nuclear-related facilities; Iran continues repeated missile salvos against Israeli population centres and military targets.

events.title: Israel strikes Iranian state broadcaster IRIB
events.summary: Israel strikes the headquarters of Iranian state broadcaster IRIB while it is broadcasting. Iranian missile attacks on Israel continue.

events.title: Israel says wartime chief of staff Ali Shadmani is killed
events.summary: Israel says it has killed Ali Shadmani, appointed wartime chief of staff only days earlier.

events.title: Israel attacks centrifuge-related sites; Iran says it uses Sejjil missiles
events.summary: Israel attacks dozens of targets, including facilities connected with centrifuge production; Iran says it uses Sejjil ballistic missiles in retaliatory attacks.

events.title: Iranian missile hits Soroka Medical Center
events.summary: An Iranian missile hits Soroka Medical Center in Beersheba. Around 40 people are reported injured; the directly affected section had been evacuated.

events.title: Israeli attacks hit nuclear-related installations near Isfahan
events.summary: Israeli attacks hit nuclear-related installations around Isfahan. The IAEA reports no hazardous off-site radiological release.

events.title: United States directly strikes Iranian nuclear sites
events.summary: The United States directly enters the war, using bombers and other weapons against Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan nuclear sites. The IAEA confirms the facilities were struck and reports no increase in off-site radiation at that stage.

events.title: Iran retaliates against U.S. forces at Al Udeid Air Base
events.summary: Iran retaliates against the United States with missiles aimed at Al Udeid Air Base in Qatar. Iran provides advance warning; missiles are intercepted and no deaths are reported.

events.title: Trump announces phased Iran-Israel ceasefire
events.summary: Trump announces that Israel and Iran have agreed to a phased ceasefire after contacts with Netanyahu and indirect U.S.-Iran communications.

events.title: Ceasefire broadly takes hold, ending the Twelve-Day War
events.summary: After several turbulent hours and mutual accusations of violations, the ceasefire broadly takes hold, ending the Twelve-Day War.

events.title: Iran suspends cooperation with the IAEA
events.summary: President Masoud Pezeshkian implements legislation suspending Iranian cooperation with the IAEA, sharply reducing post-war nuclear monitoring.

events.title: E3 trigger UN sanctions snapback mechanism
events.summary: The UK, France and Germany trigger the UN sanctions snapback mechanism over Iran's nuclear compliance, beginning the process for restoration of previous UN sanctions.

events.title: Israel launches strikes against Sanaa
events.summary: Israel launches strikes against Sanaa following continuing Houthi missile and drone attacks.

events.title: Another major Israeli strike hits Sanaa
events.summary: Another major Israeli strike hits Sanaa amid the continuing Israel-Houthi exchange.

events.title: New U.S.-backed Gaza ceasefire enters force
events.summary: A new U.S.-backed Gaza ceasefire enters force.

events.title: Remaining living Israeli hostages released under ceasefire
events.summary: The remaining living Israeli hostages held by Hamas are released as part of the agreement; Israel releases close to 2,000 Palestinian prisoners and detainees.

events.title: Large protests begin in Iran
events.summary: Large protests begin amid a sharp deterioration in the rial, inflation and economic conditions, becoming important domestic context before the 2026 war.

events.title: Iran imposes major internet shutdown amid protests
events.summary: Iranian authorities impose a major internet shutdown amid nationwide anti-government protests.

events.title: Trump tells Iranian protesters to continue protesting
events.summary: Trump publicly tells Iranian protesters to continue protesting, saying help is on its way, while U.S. military forces continue moving into the region.

events.title: U.S. and Iran open indirect nuclear negotiations mediated by Oman
events.summary: The United States and Iran open a new round of indirect nuclear negotiations mediated by Oman.

events.title: Senior U.S. and Iranian delegations resume negotiations in Geneva
events.summary: Senior U.S. and Iranian delegations resume negotiations in Geneva.

events.title: Trump gives Iran roughly 10–15 days for a meaningful nuclear agreement
events.summary: Trump says Iran has roughly 10–15 days to reach a meaningful nuclear agreement, otherwise bad things will happen. This is the first clear pre-war clock.

events.title: Oman reports positive push in negotiations
events.summary: Oman reports a positive push in negotiations but acknowledges significant unresolved differences.

events.title: Third U.S.-Iran negotiating round ends with claimed progress
events.summary: A third negotiating round ends; Oman says significant progress has been made and further talks are expected.

events.title: Oman says Iran accepts stockpile reduction in principle
events.summary: Oman says Iran has agreed in principle to reduce nuclear stockpiles to the lowest level possible under the emerging framework. Trump says he prefers diplomacy but retains other options.

events.title: United States and Israel launch coordinated attacks on Iran
events.summary: The United States and Israel launch coordinated large-scale attacks on Iran, beginning the present war. Targets include leadership, missile, air-defence and other military sites.

events.title: Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei killed
events.summary: Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei is killed during the opening attacks. Iranian state media subsequently confirms his death. Other senior political and military officials are also killed.

events.title: Iran launches immediate regional missile and drone retaliation
events.summary: Iran immediately launches missiles and drones toward Israel and U.S. or allied military facilities across the Gulf region.

events.title: Strike hits girls' school in Minab
events.summary: A strike hits a girls' school in Minab, killing a very large number of children. Iranian figures later range around 165–168 deaths. A UN investigation is subsequently opened. Preliminary U.S. military findings reported by Reuters suggest a U.S. weapon may have been responsible, but no definitive public attribution has yet been established.

events.title: Iran sharply restricts shipping through the Strait of Hormuz
events.summary: Iran sharply restricts shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and begins enforcing control over vessel movements.

events.title: Hezbollah joins the 2026 war
events.summary: Hezbollah joins the war, firing toward Israel in response to the killing of Khamenei and Israeli attacks. Israel intensifies attacks in Lebanon.

events.title: Israel expands operations against Hezbollah in Lebanon
events.summary: Israel expands air and ground operations against Hezbollah positions, creating another major displacement wave in Lebanon.

events.title: Heavy Lebanon fighting continues as incidents affect Erbil
events.summary: Heavy Israel-Hezbollah fighting continues; meanwhile drone and missile incidents affect sites around Erbil as Iranian-aligned forces and U.S. assets across the region become part of the wider exchange.

events.title: Iran announces Mojtaba Khamenei as new Supreme Leader
events.summary: Iranian authorities announce Mojtaba Khamenei as Iran's new Supreme Leader.

events.title: Heavy U.S.-Israeli strikes and Iranian regional retaliation
events.summary: The U.S. and Israel carry out some of the heaviest strikes of the war to that point. Iran launches retaliatory attacks against U.S. facilities or areas near them in Qatar, Iraq, UAE and Bahrain, as well as Israel.

events.title: U.S. forces strike more than 90 military targets on Kharg Island
events.summary: U.S. forces attack more than 90 military targets on Kharg Island but deliberately spare the island's central oil infrastructure. Iran retaliates against targets in the UAE and threatens maritime traffic.

events.title: UN body investigates Minab school strike
events.summary: Reuters reports that a UN investigative body is examining the Minab school strike; preliminary U.S. military analysis suggests U.S. forces may have caused it. The investigation remains unresolved.

events.title: Iran warns of zero restraint against regional energy infrastructure
events.summary: Iranian officials warn of zero restraint against regional energy infrastructure if Iranian energy facilities are attacked. Israel signals that a ground component remains possible.

events.title: Trump gives Iran 48 hours to fully reopen Hormuz
events.summary: Trump gives Iran 48 hours to fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz, threatening to obliterate Iranian power plants if it does not comply.

events.title: Iranian missiles hit areas around Dimona and Arad
events.summary: Iranian missile attacks hit areas around Dimona and Arad in Israel, causing injuries, while Tehran threatens retaliatory attacks against U.S.-linked energy infrastructure in the Gulf if Trump's threat is implemented.

events.title: Trump postpones threatened power-plant attacks for five days
events.summary: Before carrying out the threatened power-plant attacks, Trump announces a five-day postponement, claiming productive discussions with Iran. Tehran says there have been no direct negotiations with Washington.

events.title: Hostilities continue despite claimed diplomatic progress
events.summary: Military operations continue despite Trump's claim of diplomatic progress; U.S. and Iranian accounts of negotiations remain contradictory.

events.title: Trump grants another 10-day pause
events.summary: Trump grants another 10-day pause, setting approximately April 6 at 8 p.m. Eastern Time as the new point after which attacks on Iranian power infrastructure could resume.

events.title: U.S. and Israeli strikes expand against Iranian infrastructure
events.summary: U.S. and Israeli strikes expand against Iranian military, industrial and nuclear-related infrastructure. Iran threatens reciprocal attacks against industrial targets and continues missile and drone retaliation.

events.title: Trump says operations could be finished within two or three weeks
events.summary: Trump says he believes U.S. military operations could be finished within two or three weeks. This is a forecast for war duration, not a two-week ultimatum to Tehran.

events.title: Trump sets final April 7 deadline
events.summary: Trump replaces the previous deadline with a final deadline of April 7 at 8 p.m. ET, demanding an agreement and safe reopening of the Strait of Hormuz or threatening broad attacks against Iranian power plants and bridges.

events.title: Trump intensifies threat as deadline approaches
events.summary: Trump intensifies the threat as the deadline approaches, warning of catastrophic consequences if Tehran refuses.

events.title: Pakistan seeks two-week extension to Trump's deadline
events.summary: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif asks Trump for a two-week extension or ceasefire while pressing Iran to reopen Hormuz. Pakistan's military leadership is involved in the mediation.

events.title: Trump accepts two-week U.S.-Iran ceasefire
events.summary: Less than 90 minutes before his deadline, Trump accepts a Pakistani-mediated two-week ceasefire conditional on the immediate and safe opening of the Strait of Hormuz. Trump credits Shehbaz Sharif and Field Marshal Asim Munir. Iran's foreign minister confirms a tentative understanding.

events.title: U.S.-Iran ceasefire largely takes effect
events.summary: The ceasefire largely takes effect after roughly 40 days of direct U.S.-Iran war, although maritime restrictions and fighting involving allied actors are not fully resolved.

events.title: JD Vance travels to Islamabad for U.S.-Iran negotiations
events.summary: Vice President JD Vance travels to Islamabad, accompanied by senior U.S. negotiators including Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, for direct or mediated negotiations with an Iranian delegation hosted by Pakistan.

events.title: Vance says 21 hours of talks produced no agreement
events.summary: Vance says negotiations have lasted approximately 21 hours but acknowledges that no agreement has been reached.

events.title: Trump announces further pressure on Hormuz traffic
events.summary: Following the unsuccessful Islamabad talks, Trump announces further pressure on traffic into and out of the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Iranian forces fire on two Indian vessels
events.summary: Iranian forces fire on two Indian vessels amid continuing enforcement actions around Hormuz.

events.title: U.S. forces seize Iranian container ship Touska
events.summary: U.S. forces seize the Iranian container ship Touska amid the increasingly unstable maritime ceasefire.

events.title: Maritime confrontation involving vessel Tifani
events.summary: A further maritime confrontation involves the vessel Tifani.

events.title: Trump indefinitely extends U.S.-Iran ceasefire
events.summary: Hours before the original two-week ceasefire would expire, Trump extends it indefinitely to allow negotiations to continue.

events.title: IRGC fires on and seizes commercial vessels
events.summary: The IRGC fires on several vessels and seizes ships including MSC Francesca and Epaminondas, illustrating that the political ceasefire has not restored normal Hormuz shipping.

events.title: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire arrangement extended
events.summary: The separate Israel-Lebanon ceasefire arrangement is extended by roughly three weeks following negotiations in Washington.

events.title: Further Pakistan-mediated negotiations fail to produce breakthrough
events.summary: A new Pakistan-mediated attempt produces no breakthrough; reporting indicates the Iranian foreign minister leaves Islamabad before later U.S. envoys arrive.

events.title: UAE reports Iranian attacks affecting Fujairah
events.summary: The UAE reports Iranian missile and drone attacks affecting the Fujairah area and a refinery fire; three Indian workers are reported wounded.

events.title: Trump pauses Project Freedom Hormuz escort operation
events.summary: Trump pauses the planned U.S. Project Freedom Hormuz escort operation while negotiations continue.

events.title: U.S. and Iranian forces exchange fire near Hormuz
events.summary: U.S. and Iranian forces exchange fire near the Strait. Iran says U.S. forces attacked ships and Qeshm; CENTCOM describes its actions as defensive.

events.title: Israeli strikes in Lebanon kill at least two dozen, according to Lebanese authorities
events.summary: Israeli strikes in Lebanon kill at least two dozen people according to Lebanese authorities, adding pressure to the separate Israel-Lebanon ceasefire.

events.title: Further shipping incidents occur off Oman and Fujairah
events.summary: Further shipping incidents occur off Oman and Fujairah, including a livestock vessel sinking and an unauthorized boarding incident.

events.title: Israel and Lebanon extend ceasefire framework by 45 days
events.summary: Israel and Lebanon extend their ceasefire framework by another 45 days.

events.title: Trump threatens that nothing will be left if Iran refuses a deal
events.summary: Trump threatens that if Tehran does not agree to U.S. terms, nothing will be left of Iran. Unlike March and April, he does not attach a precise timer.

events.title: Drone incident near Barakah nuclear power plant
events.summary: A drone incident occurs near the perimeter of the UAE's Barakah nuclear power plant. No injuries or radiation release are reported. UAE authorities do not definitively attribute the drone to Iran.

events.title: Trump says planned attack has been postponed
events.summary: Trump says he has postponed a planned attack a little while, hopefully maybe forever, because discussions are occurring.

events.title: Trump says an agreement is largely negotiated
events.summary: Trump says an agreement is largely negotiated, subject to finalisation. No final agreement follows immediately.

events.title: U.S. and Iran trade attacks during ceasefire
events.summary: The U.S. strikes Iranian missile-related sites and boats it says were involved in mine-laying. Iran says it shoots down a U.S. drone and fires on an aircraft. Both sides accuse the other of violating the truce.

events.title: Israel conducts another major round of attacks in Lebanon
events.summary: Israel conducts another major round of attacks in Lebanon; Lebanese authorities report dozens killed.

events.title: U.S. and Iran exchange attacks around Hormuz and Gulf bases
events.summary: The U.S. reports intercepting Iranian missiles and drones aimed toward Gulf states and Hormuz and strikes Iranian coastal radar installations. Iran says it retaliates against U.S. bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

events.title: Trump says U.S. wants total victory within two weeks
events.summary: Trump says the U.S. wants total victory within the next two weeks and says Iran is prepared to concede extensively. This is not framed as a formal two-week deadline.

events.title: Iran announces full closure of the Strait of Hormuz
events.summary: Iran announces a full closure of the Strait of Hormuz, saying vessels attempting unauthorized transit may be fired upon.

events.title: U.S. and Iran exchange attacks around the Strait and Gulf infrastructure
events.summary: The United States and Iran exchange attacks around the Strait of Hormuz and Gulf infrastructure.

events.title: Trump threatens control of Iranian oil and gas, then calls off planned attacks
events.summary: Trump threatens U.S. total control of Iranian oil and gas infrastructure. Hours later, he says a negotiating breakthrough has occurred and calls off planned attacks.

events.title: U.S. and Iran announce ceasefire and peace framework
events.summary: Trump announces that Washington and Tehran have reached a ceasefire and peace framework. Iran's deputy foreign minister confirms that a framework exists.

events.title: 14-point Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding publicly confirmed
events.summary: The United States publicly transmits or confirms the 14-point Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding negotiated with Pakistani mediation.

events.title: Commercial vessel using Omani-approved route is struck
events.summary: A commercial vessel using an Omani-approved shipping route is struck off Oman. Washington blames Iran; Tehran argues that vessels outside approved procedures cannot be guaranteed safe passage.

events.title: U.S. conducts new strikes after alleged Iranian violations
events.summary: U.S. forces conduct new strikes after renewed accusations of Iranian violations, demonstrating that the MoU has already begun to fray operationally.

events.title: CENTCOM begins new large-scale strike wave after tanker incidents
events.summary: After three commercial vessels or tankers are struck by projectiles around Hormuz, CENTCOM begins a new large-scale strike wave against Iran.

events.title: CENTCOM says it hits more than 80 targets
events.summary: CENTCOM says it hits more than 80 targets, including Iranian air defences, command-and-control facilities, coastal radar, anti-ship missile infrastructure and more than 60 IRGC small boats.

claims.claim: Damage and target counts are based on U.S. military assessments.

events.title: Trump declares June MoU effectively over
events.summary: Trump declares the June MoU effectively over. Iran launches or claims retaliatory attacks against U.S. facilities in Bahrain and Kuwait.

claims.claim: Individual Iranian hit claims require case-by-case verification.

events.title: Trump sends Congress War Powers notification
events.summary: Trump sends Congress a War Powers notification stating that renewed hostilities began on July 7.

events.title: Iran again announces closure of Hormuz and expands regional attacks
events.summary: Iran again announces the closure of Hormuz and expands missile and drone operations against U.S. facilities throughout the Gulf following U.S. attacks.

events.title: Third consecutive night of U.S. strikes followed by Iranian regional retaliation
events.summary: A third consecutive night of U.S. strikes is followed by Iranian attacks aimed at U.S. facilities in Bahrain, Kuwait and Jordan. The UAE attributes attacks on two tankers in Omani waters to Iranian cruise missiles; an Indian crewmember is killed.

events.title: U.S. reimposes naval blockade
events.summary: U.S. strikes continue. Washington reimposes a naval blockade effective that evening.

events.title: U.S. strikes Greater Tunb and southern Iranian coastal sites
events.summary: U.S. attacks include Greater Tunb and southern Iranian coastal sites. Iran reports fatalities at Bampour. A reported strike on a wheat silo becomes disputed, with Washington denying responsibility.

events.title: U.S. strikes expand toward Tehran
events.summary: U.S. strikes expand further north and toward the Tehran area; a tanker is disabled during the continuing maritime confrontation.

events.title: Sixth consecutive night of U.S. strikes and broad Iranian retaliation
events.summary: Sixth consecutive night of U.S. strikes. Iran retaliates against U.S. or allied facilities and areas in Bahrain, Iraq, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Jordan and Syria.

claims.claim: Individual damage claims vary and require case-by-case verification.

events.title: Iranian attack in Jordan kills two U.S. military personnel
events.summary: An Iranian missile or drone attack on a U.S. position in Jordan kills two U.S. military personnel; another servicemember is initially listed missing.

events.title: Third U.S. servicemember dies in Iraq during ordnance disposal
events.summary: U.S. strikes continue for an eighth night. A third U.S. servicemember dies in northern Iraq during a controlled detonation of unexploded ordnance from a downed Iranian drone, not in the Jordan attack.

events.title: Trump vows retaliation; Houthis announce Saudi naval-blockade campaign
events.summary: Trump says Iran will pay many times over for U.S. deaths. The Houthis separately announce a naval-blockade campaign against Saudi Arabia following attacks on Yemen.

events.title: U.S. strikes around Bushehr, Ahvaz and Jask
events.summary: Roughly the twelfth consecutive night of U.S. operations includes strikes around Bushehr, Ahvaz and Jask. Iran threatens attacks on infrastructure in response.

events.title: Fighting continues across Iran, Gulf and Red Sea theatres
events.summary: U.S. strikes continue; Iranian attacks affect Kuwait and Jordan; a tanker catches fire around Hormuz. Houthis separately claim attacks on Saudi tankers in the Red Sea.

events.title: U.S. pauses strikes and Iran reciprocally halts major retaliation
events.summary: After nearly two weeks of renewed fighting, the United States pauses strikes and Iran reciprocally halts major retaliatory operations.

events.title: Military pause holds amid conflicting claims about talks
events.summary: The pause broadly holds. Trump says good talks are under way; Iranian officials publicly deny seeking direct negotiations and insist that Tehran still controls Hormuz.

events.title: Trump says parties have reached the perimeters of a deal
events.summary: Trump says the parties have reached the perimeters of a deal while also warning that U.S. forces remain ready to resume attacks.

events.title: Mediation efforts resume after military pause
events.summary: Mediation efforts resume through intermediaries following the military pause.

events.title: Trump gives Iran one last chance before decapitation
events.summary: Trump tells Iran it has one last chance before decapitation to make an agreement. Unlike March and April, he provides no specific number of hours or days. Tehran says no direct talks are under way while Trump says discussions are occurring.

events.title: June MoU's 60-day negotiating window reaches expiry
events.summary: The 60-day negotiating window envisaged by the June MoU reaches its expiry point. Iran says the deadline has lost relevance because Washington violated the agreement; major provisions had already ceased functioning during July's renewed fighting.

events.title: Washington intensifies secondary-sanctions campaign
events.summary: Washington intensifies its secondary-sanctions campaign, targeting banks and entities accused of enabling Iranian trade and sanction evasion.

events.title: Trump says international waters in Hormuz have been demined
events.summary: Trump says international waters in Hormuz have been demined, warning of zero tolerance for new Iranian mines.

events.title: Pakistan and Iran report significant mediation progress
events.summary: Pakistan and Iran report significant progress in mediation, with Field Marshal Asim Munir again playing an important role, including discussions concerning Hormuz.

events.title: U.S. begins returning diplomatic personnel to regional posts
events.summary: The United States begins returning some diplomatic personnel to Middle Eastern posts evacuated or reduced during the conflict.

events.title: Qatar's prime minister travels to Tehran for mediation
events.summary: Qatar's prime minister travels to Tehran for mediation. The White House simultaneously says the United States is not currently in negotiations with Iran, contradicting some earlier rhetoric suggesting talks were under way.

events.title: Iran sets conditions for fully reopening Hormuz
events.summary: Iran publicly sets conditions for fully reopening Hormuz, including an end to regional hostilities, removal of the blockade, compensation and sanctions relief; Tehran confirms continuing Iran-Oman talks concerning future Strait arrangements.

events.title: Washington rejects simple return to June MoU framework
events.summary: Washington rejects returning simply to the June ceasefire and MoU framework and reiterates that no active U.S.-Iran negotiations are taking place.

events.title: IRGC Navy says Iran retains full control of Hormuz
events.summary: The IRGC Navy says Iran retains full control of the Strait and will maintain restrictions until the United States ends military action and fulfils previous commitments.

events.title: U.S. drones strike two Iranian launch positions on Larak Island
events.summary: U.S. drones strike two Iranian rocket-launch positions on Larak Island. Washington says IRGC personnel were preparing rockets and naval mines. It is the first acknowledged U.S. strike on Iran since the late-July pause.

claims.claim: IRGC personnel were preparing rockets and naval mines.

events.title: Iran reports casualties from Larak strike
events.summary: Iran says the Larak attack killed or injured fighters and civilians.

events.title: Iran launches ballistic missiles toward two U.S. bases in Jordan
events.summary: Iran retaliates by launching ballistic missiles toward two U.S. bases in Jordan. Most are intercepted and no major damage is reported.

events.title: Iran claims attack on UAE's Al Minhad Air Base
events.summary: Iran claims an attack on the UAE's Al Minhad Air Base. The UAE denies that the claimed strike succeeded.

events.title: Trump posts AI-generated video appearing to show Kharg Island destroyed
events.summary: Trump posts an AI-generated video appearing to show Iran's Kharg Island being destroyed and writes that the island is being blown to smithereens. The Pentagon and White House do not substantiate a new attack and Iranian and NIOC officials say Kharg remains operational.

events.title: U.S. signals weekly secondary-sanctions actions
events.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says Washington is moving toward weekly secondary-sanctions actions, initially targeting banks involved in Iranian trade.

substantive_terms.summary: Immediate halt to military operations on the covered fronts.
Parties aim to negotiate a comprehensive agreement within 60 days, extendable by mutual consent.
Removal begins immediately; intended complete termination within roughly 30 days.
Iran undertakes best efforts to permit safe commercial transit, initially without passage fees for approximately 60 days.
Navigation and mine-clearance measures intended to restore normal traffic within about 30 days.
Iran and Oman enter talks over a longer-term Hormuz management and security framework.
Regional partners would develop at least a $300 billion economic and reconstruction package, conditional on a durable settlement.
Nuclear status quo maintained while the final arrangement is negotiated.
No new sanctions or additional deployments contemplated while the framework is operating.
Oil waivers and frozen-asset mechanisms to be addressed as implementation progresses.
An implementation and verification mechanism is envisaged.
A comprehensive settlement is intended ultimately to receive backing through a binding UN Security Council resolution.

trump_iran_deadline_ledger.action: Said Iran had roughly 10–15 days to make a meaningful nuclear deal.
Ordered Iran to fully reopen Hormuz or face attacks on power plants.
Postponed the threatened attacks, citing purported diplomatic progress.
Said U.S. operations might be finished within two or three weeks.
Issued what he called a final deadline for a deal and safe opening of Hormuz.
Accepted Pakistan's proposal for a two-week U.S.-Iran ceasefire less than 90 minutes before the deadline.
Extended the ceasefire rather than allowing it to expire.
Threatened that nothing will be left if Iran refused a deal.
Said a planned strike had been put off while talks proceeded.
Predicted or declared pursuit of total victory within two weeks.
Threatened total control over Iranian oil and gas, then cancelled imminent attacks after claiming diplomatic progress.
Said the perimeters of a deal existed while warning the U.S. remained ready to strike.

trump_iran_deadline_ledger.duration_or_clock: one last chance; no numeric duration
trump_iran_deadline_ledger.action: Warned Iran of decapitation unless it reached an agreement.
